intro: Lesson 12: Timed Section C: what the mark scheme rewards and a walking-talking run. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Objective
Middle levels
Top levels
rows: perceptive, subtle; sharply focused on purpose and reader; controlled structure
extensive vocabulary used strategically; varied sentences; consistently accurate

model.title: Task: 'Describe a place at the moment a storm arrives.'

parts.text: Plan: wide, lens, object, senses, return

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The harbour knew before we did. Boats tugged at their ropes, gulls rose in a single white sheet, and far out, the horizon had turned the colour of a bruise.

keywords.def: a mark band on the mark scheme
communicating effectively: ideas, form, tone, structure
accurate writing with a range of vocabulary and sentences
a practice where the teacher talks through each step

questions.q: Read the mid-level paragraph on the pupil PDF: name one AO4 and one AO5 improvement.
questions.a: For example: AO4: a clearer dominant mood; AO5: fix the comma splices and vary sentence openings.
Choose 2, plan 5, write 33, edit 5 (or a justified variation).

questions.q: Core: walking-talking practice in the portal response box: plan (5 minutes) and write the first two paragraphs (13 minutes) for 'Describe a place at the moment a storm arrives.' Starter: 'The ... knew before we did.'
questions.a: A plan and two controlled paragraphs at the top-level standard.

questions.q: Extend: check your two paragraphs with the success ladder.
questions.a: A self-assessed level with a reason.

questions.q: Stretch: write your final line now, before the middle.
Which is most likely to lift a piece to the top AO4 level?
options: Deliberate structure and tone sharply suited to the task
questions.a: C) Deliberate structure and tone sharply suited to the task. Control and focus are rewarded, not length or dialogue for its own sake.

questions.q: In 45 minutes, writing time is about...
Answer the ponder in one sentence.
questions.a: Control: every choice of structure, word and sentence is deliberate and suits the task.
